revisions.text: The world hates you less when they gaze upon you, they realize all they can never achieve. Soon, your critics will be silenced.
The world hates you, Lash, but when they gaze upon you, they realize all that they can never achieve. But soon, your critics will be silenced.
The world hates you lash, for when they gaze upon you they realize all that they can never achieve.  But soon, your critics will be silenced.
